# Whisper 1.8.6 API headers

Unmodified headers from ggml-org/whisper.cpp tag v1.8.6 (MIT license).
Only build-time declarations are vendored. Runtime libraries remain supplied by the local Whisper installation.
The bridge checks whisper_version before using by-value structs; other versions use CLI fallback.
Pinned headers make clean builds independent of Homebrew development headers.
